scenario: close('graceful') while a turn was still running
how: live run against opencode/deepseek-v4-flash-free, closed 2s in
note: Distinct from `cancelled`, which is the same signal with our own bookkeeping saying we asked for it. Captured after fixing `close('graceful')`, which used to kill the child and close the event queue in the same breath -- the turn settled into a closed stream and the verdict reached `snapshot()` but never a consumer following events().
